verdict.rationale: cubic's memory-and-learning docs say it learns team conventions from direct feedback: it remembers comment replies "for next time" and uses thumbs up/down to calibrate to the codebase. It also extracts patterns from senior engineers' historical code reviews. Repo context files and custom agents further encode conventions applied to future PRs. Community comments question the approach philosophically but do not contradict that it works. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that learned memory measurably changes later reviews, and documentation of how stored memories can be viewed, edited, or scoped.
